findings.mechanism: run_chain typed boundary: only descriptor-producing objects (Descriptor/Discretized/ProblemBundle) enter; reduce System IR / Normalization objects raise TypedBoundaryError whose text names pipeline_normalize as the System-IR lane entry. Asserted executably, not documented.

closure_carry='projected' makes the projected descriptor the ONLY downstream carrier; gramian_scaling is re-derived on it (alpha_carried = lam_max_proj/(2π·B_hw·margin)); both scalings are in ChainResult.scaling_full_record.

interface input domain is declared 'field': run_chain(field=) hands the physical field to choose_interface as an EVIDENCE stage (domain_in='field'); a wrong-length input raises ChainCompositionError; a workload without a field records 'interface not applicable' explicitly. The modal<->field representation transform (§5.7 T) is the declared boundary.
omega_max = max|lambda|/alpha = 2π·scaled.bandwidth() asserted positively on every lane; model/physical conventions closed.

basis winner composed into the scaled lane: T⁻¹AT dust-cleaned (1e-12·max|A|), scaling re-derived in T coordinates (B_v = α⁻¹·S_z·B_z, external TF + eig invariance asserted), p7's a_tol edge-admission mask applied to the ONE descriptor handed to both emit_route_contracts and generate_config ⇒ contract edge set == coeff edge set asserted in-chain.
run_chain typed boundary (asserted on System IR; pipeline_normalize stays typed on Descriptor).
diffusion projected lane: scaling re-derived on the projected carrier; alpha ratio 0.25 == spectrum ratio; both scalings ledgered.
field-domain interface evidence in the diffusion chain; 'not applicable' recorded on the synthetic lane (no field).

eigenvector lane composed into basis-T coordinates (dust-cleaned T⁻¹AT, re-derived scaling, eig/TF/alpha invariance asserted); identity lane: p7 a_tol edge admission applied to the single descriptor both consumers see ⇒ 6==6 edge sets with contract ordinals aligned.
